name: Mushroom Sandwich with Avocado-Mayo Spread, Arugula, Tomato & Carrot

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ avocados
3 tomatoes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, paprika, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp paprika
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with marinade, and turn to coat. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place mushrooms in the oven and roast until tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out into the reserved bowl.
Add nutritional yeast, mayo, and spices to the bowl with the avocado; mash with a potato masher or fork until smooth. Set avocado mayo aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup nutritional yeast flakes
½ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes. Peel, trim, and coarsely grate the carrots. Transfer both to a large plate and set aside.
Place bread slices on a flat surface and spread evenly with a avocado mayo. Top half the slices with mushrooms, tomato, carrot, and arugula. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates and enjoy!
